write_up: Your resume points to family services casework: you moved from assistance intake at Lakeview Community Center to child protective services work at Cuyahoga Family Partners. This is a common way to describe casework, but the recent role mostly lists duties without showing how many families you carry or what goes into the cases. That makes it difficult to stand out among other caseworkers.

The monthly family team meetings line is the best model: it names an action and tells a recruiter how often you do it. Your Ohio LMSW and child welfare specialty are easy to find, and Experience is in the right place above Education.

Let's start with the caseload line, then add the details you can substantiate about assessments, service coordination and court reports. You don't need a number everywhere, but a few concrete details about the families and decisions in your work will make the role more distinct.
